en: At the start of each day, marks one unopened cell as a Rat Nest. The demo uses a two-round hatch and a Rare Colossal Rat; settings can be calibrated.

en: A Colossal Rat can Consume another Colossal Rat of the same tier and gains 1 extra tier afterward; its Code may still change.

en: Cell-opening rarity weights and the four Code weights are practice parameters; no measured probabilities are available.

zh: 经营限制
en: Management Limits

zh: 演示每个游戏日换一次；吃不占游戏日；被消耗的牢房可重新打开。均待正式规则核准。
en: The demo allows one replacement per game day; Consume does not use a game day; consumed cells can be reopened. All await confirmation against the official rules.

zh: 触发顺序
en: Trigger Order

zh: 默认口枷按吃前人数，绮彩不计场上；依次处理口枷、鼠头串、锈锯、复仇者之匣。可切换判定。
en: By default, Gag of Agony checks the pre-Consume count and excludes Chromatic Inmates from the board count; Gag of Agony, Rat Head Necklace, Rusty Saw, then Avenger’s Box resolve in order. The check can be changed.

zh: 目标与卡池
en: Objectives and Card Pools

zh: 仅复刻已确认的至臻目标，完成后选一个刑具；卡池均为已展示条目，不代表完整池。
en: Only the confirmed Ultimate objective is reproduced. Completing it grants one Torture Instrument choice; all card pools contain displayed entries only and do not represent the complete pools.

zh: 鼠巢与事件
en: Rat Nests and Incidents

zh: 演示两轮孵化稀有硕鼠；事件出现率、环形邻接、处刑效率同阶筛选均为假设。
en: The demo hatches a Rare Colossal Rat after two rounds; incident rate, circular adjacency, and same-tier filtering for Execution Efficiency are assumptions.

zh: 升阶处理
en: Rarity Upgrade Handling

zh: 普通吃后变号；刑具额外升阶合并结算、不额外变号；佳酿默认不变号。封顶和先后待核准。
en: A normal Consume changes Code afterward; extra tiers from Torture Instruments resolve together without another Code change; Crimson Vintage keeps Codes unchanged by default. Caps and order await confirmation.

zh: 暴乱与奖励
en: Riot and Rewards

en: Combat is simulated in three rarity groups and represented by development points. Power, difficulty, and points do not represent actual drops, prices, or returns.
